facts.fact: Lacey 深夜电话：承认之前撒谎——与四人组的交道比说出来的深。
facts.anchor: I also wanted to say that… I lied, and I don’t feel good about this.

facts.fact: 她不在站里说的原因：「你永远不知道谁在听」。
facts.anchor: you never know who’s listening, right?

facts.fact: 有些副手与四人组紧密——一起打橄榄球长大、至今密切。
facts.anchor: they’re tight with them, you know? Played football together

facts.fact: Alex 直问：有没有副手在 Grant Walker 的工资单上？Lacey 惊讶否认但不确定。
facts.anchor: Are any of your deputies on Grant Walker’s payroll?

facts.fact: April 家门口的守卫不是 Lacey 派的——Keller/Walker 打电话自己安排。
facts.anchor: I didn’t put my deputies outside their houses, okay? They did that themselves.

facts.fact: Lacey：在 Dunning 这种地方，随大流比逆流容易。
facts.anchor: it’s easier to swim with the tide than against it sometimes

facts.fact: 过去几年有些报警——问题后来就自动消失。
facts.anchor: we’ve had some calls over the last few years—problems that just sort of… went away.

facts.fact: Dawes 与 Grant 一起长大（最好的朋友）；想快知道他们干什么的就去找他。
facts.anchor: he grew up with Grant and the others, you know, like best friends

facts.fact: Alex 拒绝 Lacey 陪同——独自去找 Dawes。
facts.anchor: I’ll handle this on my own.
